prediction_target.definition: Dataset-curated binary LEGITIMATE vs PHISHING target for compatibility; parser verdicts are not ground truth.
prediction_target.source: Approved or explicitly provisional dataset label, separate from the feature object.

separation.raw_evidence: Existing parse_email result; immutable input and source paths retained.
separation.normalized_features: Bounded deterministic transformations with explicit missingness and provenance.
separation.model_output: Reserved null field populated only by a trained classifier at inference time.
separation.final_risk_score: Reserved null field for downstream policy/risk fusion; never a training feature.

split_policy.source_grouping: Enabled when at least three distinct source/source_group values exist.
split_policy.time_aware: Used only when every row has a timezone-aware timestamp; otherwise stable seeded hash grouping.
split_policy.near_duplicate_grouping: Canonical exact duplicates are collapsed before candidate generation; local SimHash bands use token-set Jaccard >= 0.80; oversized first-pass buckets are refined with a second independent band, and refined buckets above 250 remain bounded/skipped. Approximate only; semantic variants can be missed.
split_policy.learned_transforms: Fit only on training partition; vectorizer vocabulary is learned inside fit_text_classifier.

authentication_evidence_boundary: SPF/DKIM/DMARC values are parser-reported evidence, not independently verified authentication or proof of sender identity/legitimacy. The trust indicator reflects only an explicit parser Boolean true; no DNS/signature verification is performed by preprocessing.
training_gate: Training, calibration, and source-holdout fitting require the versioned training_approval.schema.v1.json contract: exact dataset SHA-256, hashes for every dataset component and evidence file, rights APPROVED, independent label adjudication ADJUDICATED, and privacy/retention APPROVED. No approval is inferred.
